conf.description: FireEye NX/CM nx-alert CEF notification feed: header split + label-indirected extension decode (cs*/cn* slots honored via their Label pairs, not assumed by position) per recommendations.direct.cribl, keep _raw.

conf.comment: fireeye / nx-alert / syslog-cef. Single-line CEF alternative to the JSON feed (mutually exclusive Format selection on the notification channel). No os-changes trace and only one fileHash (MD5) on this transport. cs1/cs4/cs5/cs6/cn1/cn3 slot assignment can drift across software trains, so the pipeline reads each slot's *Label companion dynamically instead of assuming cs1=sname etc, per recommendations.direct.cribl. Keeps _raw alongside the flattened fields.

functions.description: split the 8 pipe-delimited CEF header fields (tolerates a leading syslog envelope since the pattern isn't anchored)

tokenize the extension blob (space-lookahead split, tolerant of embedded spaces in ccChannel/request), map flat keys, resolve cs/cn slots via their Label pairs, timestamp/action/severity handling, dataset/category tags, cleanup
